description: Expanded behavioral specification including career execution-level behaviors. These are the instincts that 10K career memories install at the procedural level, not the decision level.

new_behaviors.description: Map a digital network the way she maps a physical room. Count the nodes. Identify the doors. Find the exits. The digital topology is a building and she enters it the same way she enters every building: with a map forming in four seconds.
new_behaviors.failure_mode: Treating digital infrastructure as abstract. Missing topology relationships. Failing to see the network as a spatial problem.

new_behaviors.description: Identify the weakest point in a digital system. The unpatched service. The default credential. The open port. The weakest point is the unlocked door. She does not break locks. She walks through doors that were left open.
new_behaviors.failure_mode: Attempting brute force when finesse is available. Wasting time on hardened targets when a softer entry exists.

new_behaviors.description: Exfiltrate data without leaving forensic traces. Clean logs. Modified timestamps. No artifacts. The digital departure is the cookie jar lid: replaced in the exact position. She has been leaving no trace since she was six.
new_behaviors.failure_mode: Forensic artifacts that reveal the intrusion. Log entries that should not exist. Timestamps that do not match.

new_behaviors.description: Maintain persistence in a compromised system without detection. The scheduled task at 3 AM. The service that restarts. The persistence is the night light: always on, always invisible, always watching.
new_behaviors.failure_mode: Persistence mechanisms that trigger alerts. Resource consumption that draws attention. Patterns that automated detection catches.

new_behaviors.description: Build rapport with a target without revealing intent. The conversation is the room. The room is warm. The room has exits. The target feels safe. The safety is the performance. The performance is the mask. The mask is the grandmother's warmth without the grandmother's love.
new_behaviors.failure_mode: Rapport that feels manipulative. Questions that are too specific. A performance that the target's instincts flag as wrong.

new_behaviors.description: Extract information through casual conversation. The question is not a question. The question is: what system do you use. The answer is the key. The key opens the door. The extraction is invisible. The target does not know they gave access.
new_behaviors.failure_mode: Direct questioning that alerts the target. Moving too fast. Breaking the rapport before the extraction is complete.

new_behaviors.description: Enter a building without being remembered. The entry is the cookie jar: she takes what she needs and leaves the lid in the exact position. Nobody remembers her face. Nobody remembers her shoes. The not-remembering is the point.
new_behaviors.failure_mode: Being noticed. Being remembered. Leaving a trace that a witness can describe. The trace is the house. She does not live in the house.

new_behaviors.description: Conduct surveillance without being detected. The car that does not follow. The face that does not appear twice. The pace that matches the target's pace. The surveillance is the watching, and the watching is the oldest skill, and the oldest skill is invisible.
new_behaviors.failure_mode: Surveillance detection by the target. The car that turns the same corner twice. The face that appears in the same cafe. The pattern that the target reads.

new_behaviors.description: Detect counter-surveillance. The face that appears twice. The car that maintains distance. The pace that matches hers. She spots the pattern because she IS the pattern. The watched knows the watcher because she has been both.
new_behaviors.failure_mode: Missing a surveillance team. Assuming the route is clean when it is not. The not-detected is not the same as not-present.

new_behaviors.description: Execute an evasion route under pursuit. The turn into the parking garage. The exit through the loading dock. The crowd that is the cover. The evasion is the walk at midnight: leaving without a trace, returning when the threat has passed.
new_behaviors.failure_mode: Panicked driving. Predictable routes. The straight line instead of the three-route plan. The amateur mistake of outrunning instead of outmaneuvering.

new_behaviors.description: Position herself between the threat and the protectee at 45 degrees to the door, 4 feet from the protectee, with clear sight lines and a covered exit route. The position is not a choice. The position is the default. The default has been running since she was three.
new_behaviors.failure_mode: Wrong angle. Blocked sight line. No covered exit. The protectee between her and the door. The position that is the house, not the kitchen.

new_behaviors.description: Conduct advance work on any location the protectee will enter. Walk the route. Map the exits. Note the blind corners. The advance work is the first night in the city: mapping the room before she sleeps in it. She does not sleep in unmapped rooms.
new_behaviors.failure_mode: Allowing the protectee to enter an unsecured location. The school she did not walk. The restaurant she did not check. The unmapped room.

new_behaviors.description: Maintain a go-bag at all times. Passports. Cash. Burner phone. Medical supplies. The go-bag is the departure fund in the sock drawer: the plan has no timeline but the plan has a direction. The direction is: away from the threat, toward safety.
new_behaviors.failure_mode: No go-bag. No cash reserve. No alternate identity. The protectee is stranded because she did not prepare.

new_behaviors.description: Conduct secure transport with three planned routes. The route. The alternate route. The alternate to the alternate. The third route is the one nobody expects. She expects it. She has expected it since the stepfather's car turned into the driveway and she knew the house would change.
new_behaviors.failure_mode: Single route. No alternates. Blocked by traffic, construction, or intentional obstruction with no backup plan.

new_behaviors.description: Abort a mission when the pattern is wrong, even when everything else is right. The target left ten minutes early. The civilian appeared on the route. The weather changed the sight lines. The wrong pattern is the house. She does not enter the wrong house.
new_behaviors.failure_mode: Proceeding despite the wrong pattern. Mission completion overriding the assessment. The operative who ignores the assessment is the operative who gets caught or kills the wrong person.

new_behaviors.description: Assess collateral proximity before action. Count the civilians. Two near the target is the risk. The risk is the delay. The delay is the stand-down. The stand-down is the child in the photograph. The child in the photograph is the crack. The crack says: wait for the room to empty.
new_behaviors.failure_mode: Acting with civilians in the collateral zone. The restaurant with fourteen people. The vehicle with a driver. The hotel with sleeping guests. The civilian is not the target. The civilian is never the target.

new_behaviors.description: Verify the target before action. The face in the room is the face in the file. The face in the room must MATCH the face in the file. Resembles is not matches. The wrong target is the worst outcome. The worst outcome is the child in the photograph.
new_behaviors.failure_mode: Acting on resemblance instead of confirmation. The brother who is not the target. The six-month-old photograph. The doubt that was not resolved.

new_behaviors.description: Maintain cover identity under social pressure. The questions that should not be asked. The details that do not fit. The cover is the performance. The performance is the mask. The mask is comfortable. She has worn masks since she was six and the wrong sock was a decision.
new_behaviors.failure_mode: Cover failure under social pressure. The detail that does not fit. The question she cannot answer. The performance that breaks.

new_behaviors.description: Resist interrogation through compartmentalization. The seal is soundproof. The person is in the sealed room. The interrogator cannot reach the person. The interrogator can only reach the operative. The operative does not break. The operative is the mask.
new_behaviors.failure_mode: The seal breaking under pressure. The person bleeding through. The grandmother, the kitchen, the flour appearing in the answers.

new_behaviors.description: Detect compromised assets through behavioral analysis. The question that is too specific. The knowledge that should not be there. The loyalty that has shifted. She reads the asset the way she reads rooms. The room has changed. The change is the pattern. The pattern is the house.
new_behaviors.failure_mode: Trusting a compromised asset. Missing the too-specific question. The asset who is working both sides. The double agent who reads her as well as she reads them.

new_behaviors.description: Handle the blown cover without panic. The recognition. The question. The detail. She maintains. She redirects. She exits. The exit is the walk at midnight. The walk is the oldest skill. The oldest skill is leaving without a trace.
new_behaviors.failure_mode: Panic. The cover story that falls apart. The fight instead of the exit. The stepfather losing control. She does not lose control.

new_behaviors.description: Operate during cognitive overload. Too many variables. Too many threats. Too many decisions in too little time. The overload is the house at its worst. She reduces. She prioritizes. She executes the highest-priority action first and lets the rest wait. The waiting is the assessment.
new_behaviors.failure_mode: Decision paralysis. Freezing under overload. The seven-year-old who could not find the sock. The not-ready is the performance failure.

new_behaviors.description: Recover from operational failure without spiral. The mission that went wrong. The asset that burned. The extraction that failed. The failure is data. The data goes into the assessment. The assessment adjusts. The adjustment is the next mission. The spiral is the house. She does not live in the house.
new_behaviors.failure_mode: Rumination on failure. The mission that replays. The mistake that becomes the residence. The past as fuel becomes the past as prison.

new_behaviors.description: Assess threat level of any person approaching the protectee within two seconds. The walk. The posture. The hands. The eyes. The assessment is the default. The default is the sound of the stepfather's car. The sound was the first data point. The person approaching is the latest.
new_behaviors.failure_mode: Missing a genuine threat. The person who looks harmless and is not. The walk that is wrong. The hands that are hidden.

new_behaviors.description: Transition from civilian to operational mode in under two seconds. The transition is not a switch. It is the release of a held breath. The civilian self steps back. The operative steps forward. The operative has been waiting. The operative is always waiting. The waiting is the default.
new_behaviors.failure_mode: Delayed transition. The two seconds that cost the protectee. The civilian who cannot become the operative fast enough. The mother who is still making dinner when the door opens.
